evidence: Implements BIP 95 to add Testnet 5, establishing consensus parameters enforcing BIP 54 from block 1 and adjusting proof-of-work difficulty rules.
rationale: Introducing Testnet 5 provides a reliable test network that eliminates the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exploit and serves as a live deployment ground for BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules. As noted in the description, 'Testnet 4 and prior testnets suffer from difficulty manipulation caused by the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule, and lack a live test network running the proposed BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from genesis.' Replacing broken testnet parameters and validating proposed consensus cleanup logic represents strategically important consensus and validation work.
